data.title: Choose the definition that matches the word.

answers.word: To believe someone is honest or reliable; to feel you can depend on them.
To officially prove who you are with documents such as a passport or ID.
To strongly dislike someone because they have something you want.
A person you work with, especially in the same job or organisation.
A close friend you spend most of your free time with outside work.
A person who lives near you in the same street or building.
The way two people, groups, or countries are connected and behave toward each other.
A short formal meeting where someone asks questions to choose the best person for a job.
A written rule made by a company that tells staff what they must do.
An informal talk between two or more people where they exchange ideas or information.
A public speech given to a large audience in a theatre or hall.
A written message sent online, such as an email or a text.
Help or encouragement that makes a person or plan more likely to succeed.
A strict rule that controls what people are allowed to do.
Money you receive because you returned something to a shop.
A feeling that you can do something successfully; self-belief.
A feeling of fear about what might happen; worry.
A promise made in writing that something is true or will happen.
Unfair treatment of people because of factors like race, gender, age, or religion.
A strong preference for one brand over another when shopping.
A fair process where everyone is treated exactly the same in all situations.
A group of people who live in the same area or share common interests.
A private conversation between two people that no one else hears.
A list of rules a company gives to its workers.
An official rule or plan used by an organisation or government to guide decisions.
A short survey where customers answer questions about a service.
A document that proves you paid for something, like a receipt.
The process of people entering and living in a country that is not their own.
The process of leaving a country permanently to live somewhere else.
The process of travelling for fun, such as sightseeing and visiting museums.
